description: Two organisms competing for one limiting substrate in a well-mixed batch culture at 37 C. The fast grower has the higher maximum rate; the gleaner has the lower half-saturation constant and so keeps growing as the substrate runs low.
assumptions: Well mixed: no spatial structure, no gradients.
One limiting substrate; all other nutrients are in excess.
Temperature and pH are constant for the whole run.
Parameters are illustrative (confidence C in docs/parameters.md) and do not describe a particular strain.
